The legal issues in the paragraph center on the enforceability of a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) in the context of an employment termination. Specifically, the case presents questions regarding whether the lack of a witness during signing and the employee's claim of unawareness of the restrictions constitute valid defenses against enforcement. These issues touch upon contract formation, mutual assent, and the specific legal requirements for NDAs in the relevant jurisdiction.
